thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Embedding ingestion failures and high write latency observed in ap-southeast (ap-sg). Some customers experiencing timeouts and delayed indexing. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1876543210

oncall-lee: taking lead. start triage: embed-store IO, network saturation, and recent config changes. @sre-kate pls join.

sre-kate: joining. Metrics: write latency p99 for embed-store > 6s, write error rate ~9%. Disk queue length rising on embed-store-az1.

eng-embed-alex: noticed a background shard-rebalance job kicked off ~30m ago (shard-mover v1.3). pausing rebalance now to stop extra IO. Command: `shardctl pause rebalance --cluster embed-ap-sg`

infra-ryan: isolating hosts with highest IO: embed-store-3 and embed-store-7. Throttling background snapshot/compaction on those nodes. Also verifying EBS burst credits on both hosts.

support-nina: posting initial customer-facing status: "We're investigating delays and timeouts for embedding ingestion in APAC. We're applying mitigations and will update at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1876543210"

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: rebalance paused, compaction throttled, and write requests diverted to healthy nodes. Observed error-rate drop: 9% -> 2.5% in ~4 minutes.

oncall-lee: applying temporary routing rule to prefer eu-region for new ingest jobs for affected customers for 1 hour. Notifying account teams.

eng-embed-alex: collecting heap and IO profiles; suspect compaction + rebalance caused IO amplification. we'll re-evaluate compaction schedule.

sre-kate: running fsck and checking for degraded disks; SMART looks ok. experimenting with increasing write buffer on embed-proxy for short window.

product-marc: alerted top APAC customers and offering 24h credit for affected ingest windows. drafting FAQ for CS.

infra-ryan: scheduling rolling restart of embed-proxy under controlled drain after traffic normalization. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-store-io-incident

support-nina: all open tickets tagged INCIDENT-1876543210 and updated with current mitigation steps.

oncall-lee: postmortem owners: @eng-embed-alex (root cause), @sre-kate (mitigation & ops), @infra-ryan (infra). ETA initial RCA: EOD.

incidents-bot: STATE: mitigated (recovering). Public page updated. Next update in 15m or earlier if regression. Thread restricted to incident leads.
